name: Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF) v1.1
description: NIST SSDF practice PW.7 includes review and analysis of human-readable code, triage of findings and documentation of remediation.
reviewSteps: Collect evidence at the reported location and verify the conditions before assigning remediation.
Rescan after fixing and record the tool, rule set and source revision.

name: Open Source Project Security Baseline
description: The OpenSSF baseline defines security controls for open source projects by category and maturity level.
reviewSteps: Check repository evidence such as installation documentation, security policy, CI permissions and version pinning.
Record the checklist version and gather evidence for each applicable control separately.

name: OWASP SAMM Security Testing
description: OWASP SAMM combines repeatable automated checks with deeper review informed by risk, application context and business logic.
reviewSteps: Run repeatable checks in CI and prioritize manual review for high-impact changes.
Review authorization and business workflows alongside findings from static analysis.

name: OWASP Benchmark and SAST accuracy measurements
description: OWASP Benchmark provides labeled cases by weakness to measure detections, false positives and misses consistently.
reviewSteps: Report precision, recall and false-positive rate with the dataset version, scan mode and denominators.
Check results on representative projects to assess how well the benchmark generalizes.

name: Open Source Vulnerability schema and version ranges
description: OSV defines advisory identifiers, ecosystems, package versions, affected ranges and range types.
reviewSteps: Use resolved lockfile versions and the comparator for the correct package ecosystem.
Read the original advisory to check affected and fixed releases. See the manifest for the source of SrcAudit's local advisory snapshot.

name: SARIF for GitHub Code Scanning
description: GitHub Code Scanning accepts SARIF results from external analysis tools. Locations, rule IDs and fingerprints help track findings across runs.
reviewSteps: Review paths and redacted evidence before publishing a SARIF file.
Upload only to approved destinations and grant the scanner and upload steps the permissions they need.

name: OpenSSF Scorecard checks for token permissions and dependency pinning
description: OpenSSF Scorecard checks workflow token permissions, dependency pinning and repository security practices.
reviewSteps: Pin GitHub Actions to verified commit SHAs and record their release versions for maintenance.
Limit token permissions and disable persisted checkout credentials when the job only reads the repository.
